import json, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/project')
src = open('stress.py').read()
src = (src.replace("range(2000)", "range(120)").replace("range(3000)", "range(300)")

exec(compile(src, 'stress_medium', 'exec'), ns)
doc = ns['doc']
print('bytes', len(json.dumps(doc)))
start = time.time(); want = __import__('ref').solve(doc); t1 = time.time()-start
start = time.time(); got = __import__('main').run(doc); t2 = time.time()-start
a = json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True); b = json.dumps(want, sort_keys=True)
print('ref %.2fs proj %.2fs match=%s' % (t1, t2, a == b))
if a != b:
    import difflib
    print('\n'.join(list(difflib.unified_diff(b.splitlines(), a.splitlines(), 'ref', 'proj', lineterm=''))[:60]))
